name: bso-local-bridge
description: Run verified BSO QGIS and VWorld graphics jobs on the user's Windows PC without exposing local secrets or services to the internet.

interface.shortDescription: Run local PNU, QGIS, and VWorld graphics gates from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local BSO graphics gate through a restricted stdio tool. The VWorld key remains in bso/.env, the HTTP server remains loopback-only, and only manifests under bso/graphics-input can run.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my local BSO graphics gate is ready.
List the verified outputs for this BSO graphics manifest.
Run this BSO graphics manifest locally after checking its PNU gate.
